This is a genuine file-read call (present in source) targeting the user's .npmrc, which typically stores npm registry auth tokens — a credential file, not merely a path string. The method name is built via string concatenation ('read' + 'FileSync') rather than written as fs.readFileSync, an obfuscation pattern with no functional benefit other than evading naive static/string scanners.
